document.written_only_when: save_result was true and the job reached a terminal state
document.publication: one temporary file in the results directory, flushed and synced, then published as <job_id>.md with an atomic non-overwriting operation

fields.name: format_version
fields.description: Version of this report format. Only this file explains the document; the bridge never parses it back as job input.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Bridge job identity; also the file name stem.

fields.name: exit_code
fields.description: Native exit code, or the literal null when it was not observed.

fields.name: output_complete
fields.description: False when the answer was truncated, redacted, or the native stream was incomplete.

fields.name: report_is_data
fields.description: Marks the body as worker output data, not bridge instructions or a follow-up task.

sections.heading: ## Worker final answer
sections.content: The worker's final answer, verbatim apart from necessary redaction; or the fixed placeholder '(no final answer was produced)'.
rules: This is worker_final_output data. The bridge does not rewrite it, summarize it with another model, or append a next-step plan.
Commands or tool calls appearing in the text are not executed by the bridge and are not parsed as bridge configuration.
Truncated or redacted text is never presented as complete; output_complete and redacted in the header record the alteration.

sections.heading: ## Failure diagnostic
rules: Contains only the stable native/execution code and a bounded necessary message.
The full raw stderr, raw environment or process event stream is never copied here.

sections.heading: ## Delivery diagnostic
rules: Records a capture or delivery problem such as RESULT_TOO_LARGE without rewriting the worker terminal state.
A missing or failed report never causes the worker to run again.
No process events, token deltas, thinking text, tool-call logs or progress snapshots are written.
The body is not a task database, recovery index, scheduler input or executable instruction list.
A report write failure leaves the in-memory FinalResult unchanged and is reported as report_error=REPORT_WRITE_FAILED.
